sharedRules.asOf: All windows end at signal date; prior means exclude specified latest candles. Calendar aligned, never compress missing sessions.
sharedRules.provider: Dataset-level expected_source must be kis or naver-fchart; mixed/mistagged inputs reject. Provider provenance is never relabeled.
sharedRules.priceValidity: Positive finite internally consistent OHLC. Missing OHLC invalidates the candle.
sharedRules.volumeValidity: Observed past volume is finite nonnegative: actual 0 is retained, absent/negative is null. Zero denominator => null. Validity of observed OHLC and volume are separate; OHLC=0 suspension rows stay invalid without carry/repair.
sharedRules.missing: Any missing observation in a stated window => null; undefined ratio/flat CLV/wick => null. Never history-fill zero.
sharedRules.wilderHistory: Latest max320 calendar-bar prefix ending at asOf, then valid contiguous OHLC suffix; ATR seeds recomputed inside that bounded suffix. All other windows are <=121 bars with direct sums, so >320 old prefix changes cannot affect them.
sharedRules.labels: No labels, model training, score fitting or stock selection performed. Future strict-five-session labels separately require positive future volume; that label guard is not imposed on observed past-volume features.
sharedRules.eligibility: Frozen actual TS memberships retain main positive current volume requirement. New setup feature availability does not change eligibility.
